description_zh: 调用该接口解除边缘实例中已绑定的角色

parameters.description_en:
The edge instance ID. To obtain the ID, go to the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), and hover your mouse over the name of the target edge instance.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的 **边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
